code-inspector-plugin 2.0.9 (MIT, https://github.com/zh-lx/code-inspector)
purpose: dev-only source mapping (element -> file:line:col) for click-to-comment on the running app (dfw review); development builds only (it does nothing in production builds).
bundler: nuxt, config: nuxt.config.ts
1. devDependency: "code-inspector-plugin": "2.0.9"  then npm install
2. by hand: nuxt.config: vite: { plugins: [codeInspectorPlugin({ bundler: 'vite', pathType: 'relative', hotKeys: false, showSwitch: false, hideConsole: true, server: 'close' })] }

Needs the user's approval at G3: list it in .dfw/stack.json dependencies, e.g.
  {"name":"code-inspector-plugin","version":"2.0.9","dev":true,"license":"MIT","purpose":"live review source mapping"}
then "dfw approve G3 ..." and "dfw inspector setup --write".
